vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the release-age wait and the PR concurrency limit, so a red audit never sits blocked behind routine dependency PRs.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes transitive dependencies once a week. CI runs verify:lockfile before npm ci, so a refresh that drops another platform's native binaries fails the PR instead of the deploy.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor updates, digest bumps, pins and lockfile maintenance when CI passes. Major bumps still require manual review.
Prisma CLI and client must move together; a mismatch fails at generate time.
Next and React share peer ranges, so they belong in one PR. Mobile is excluded: there React is pinned by the Expo SDK.
Tailwind v4 and lightningcss ship native binaries; one PR means the lockfile check judges them together.
better-auth core and its plugins are released as a set.
Node 22 is the whole stack: engines, the CI runners and the three Dockerfiles. Moving to a new major is a deliberate exercise, not a dependency PR. (20 went end-of-life in April 2026.)
Postgres stays on 16. A major bump leaves the existing data directory unreadable (pg_upgrade), and the same image backs CI, the dev compose file and the deploy stack.
Vaultwarden updates contain password database migrations; never automerge them.
Curl worker images used across docker-compose background workers move together.
Immich server and machine-learning must move together, and an upgrade touches the photo archive; never automerge it. See docs/immich-disaster-recovery.md.
Immich pins its own database and cache image; those follow upstream's compose file, not Renovate.
MinIO tags look like RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z; without its own versioning scheme Renovate cannot compare them.
The mobile app lives outside the workspaces and needs an EAS Update after every merge, so it is never automerged. See docs/app-ontwikkelen.md.
Expo ships its SDK as one set: expo, the expo-* modules, React, React Native and the babel/eslint presets belong in a single PR.
Action digest pins in one weekly PR. A major bump of an action stays manual: it can change inputs.
